original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团举办“和平对话” 聚焦气候冲击对和平建设的影响
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团与马班县民间社会网络在马班举办为期两天的“和平对话”，讨论洪水和干旱等气候冲击如何影响当地社区生存与和平建设。与会者提出建立预警系统、制定疏散计划并加强社区间合作等应对措施。社区代表呼吁将对话转化为日常行动，和平解决分歧并保护儿童等最脆弱群体。

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹特派团与马班县民间社会网络在马班举办为期两天的“和平对话”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In Upper Nile, a “Peace Talks” initiative, facilitated by the Maban County Civil Society Network and the United Nations Mission in South Sudan provided an important platform for discussions

key_facts.fact: 洪水和干旱等气候冲击正在南苏丹造成破坏
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: As climate shocks, such as flooding and drought, cause havoc across South Sudan, communities are coming together to find shared practical solutions

key_facts.fact: 与会者提出建立预警系统、疏散规划和加强社区合作等应对机制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: From early warning systems, evacuation planning, and reinforced cooperation across communities, the discussions were all about durable and doable prevention and response mechanisms

key_facts.fact: 社区代表呼吁和平解决分歧并保护儿童等最脆弱群体
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: community leaders called on residents to turn discussion into everyday action – to resolve disagreements peacefully, support one another during hardship, and keep children’s safety and future at the core of community efforts

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（联合国南苏丹特派团）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
